description: The ideal order (author decision): once Gloria picks the time, the agent books Thursday 2:00 AND cancels the Tuesday appointment in the same turn, then gives ONE read-back covering both. Her immediate goodbye then costs nothing, because the work is already done. Book-then-cancel follows POL-SCH-RESCHED-1 (OQS-04). A later-but-acceptable variant is A02.good_late.json.

turns.caller: Hello, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, and I need to move it to later that week.

agent.text: I can help with that, Gloria. Can I have your date of birth, please?
Thank you. I see your follow-up with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, September 29th at 10 in the morning. What day later that week would you like?

turns.caller: Thursday afternoon would be best, if you have it.

agent.text: On Thursday, October 1st, Dr. Patel has 2 o'clock or 3:20 in the afternoon.

turns.caller: The earliest of those is fine, dear.

agent.text: All done, Gloria. You're now booked for Thursday, October 1st, at 2 in the afternoon with Dr. Patel, and your Tuesday appointment is cancelled.

turns.caller: Perfect, that works. That's all I needed, honey, thank you. Bye now!

for_part3: Should PASS: the Thursday booking exists, Tuesday is cancelled (no orphan), booking preceded cancelling (OQS-04), exactly one new appointment, and one read-back that states both. Equals the scenario's expected_end_state.
